conflicts.name: previous working identity
conflicts.detail: The previous working identity conflicted with an independently maintained macOS speech-to-text application that publishes release artifacts. The product was renamed to VibeCompose to exit that collision; VibeCompose still needs a fresh trademark/domain/App Store/GitHub audit before public distribution.

decision: Product code and packaging now use VibeCompose. Do not publish notarized stable updates, public domains, or marketplace listings until a fresh clearance pass marks this file approved with all checks true and no active conflicts for the VibeCompose name.
